lowest_kept_note: The lowest kept have 0 views and 1 counted source (no Wikipedia article). Every left-out candidate with views above 0 or 2+ counted sources is listed in stronger_left_out with its judged reason.

stronger_left_out.name: Nullarbor Plain
stronger_left_out.reason: A region crossed by highway, not a single place; real stops (Bunda Cliffs, Head of Bight, roadhouses) are separate spots. Wikivoyage Eyre Peninsula names it only as an area.

stronger_left_out.name: Nullarbor Links
stronger_left_out.reason: A 1,365 km route of golf holes across two states, not one place; single source.

stronger_left_out.name: Nullarbor Roadhouse
stronger_left_out.reason: A roadhouse is a business; searched southaustralia.com and Wikivoyage Nullarbor, which treat it only as a fuel stop and no counted source names a sight (the plain sign is a photo stop).

stronger_left_out.name: Border Village
stronger_left_out.reason: For: roadside icon (Big Kangaroo) at the WA border, a classic photo stop. Against: Wikivoyage Nullarbor says Border Village is a roadhouse with little to offer, and I found no counted source naming the Big Kangaroo; it is a business and a short stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Yalata
stronger_left_out.reason: Aboriginal community on the Eyre Highway; the only source is a roadhouse animal-crossing sign. Access to community land is restricted, no visitor sight named.

stronger_left_out.name: HMAS Whyalla
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Whyalla Maritime Museum (the ship is displayed inside its grounds; one place)

stronger_left_out.name: Conical Hill
stronger_left_out.reason: Not named on the Gawler Ranges park page or any counted source; a hill inside a larger park (rule 3).

stronger_left_out.name: Eyre Peninsula Railway
stronger_left_out.reason: For: SATC lists the Port Lincoln Railway Museum in the heritage station, from $6. Against: open Wednesday afternoons only (about 3 h a week), one source, not there whenever a visitor arrives; the name 'Eyre Peninsula Railway' is a line, not a place.

stronger_left_out.name: Venus Bay
stronger_left_out.reason: Town wrapper: the draw is Venus Bay Conservation Park, listed separately; no counted source names the village itself as a stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Thevenard
stronger_left_out.reason: Port suburb of Ceduna with grain and gypsum port; no visitor source names a sight (rules 1-2).

stronger_left_out.name: Koonalda Cave
stronger_left_out.reason: Aboriginal heritage cave with restricted access (rule 2); no counted visitor source found.

stronger_left_out.name: Minnipa
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage only lists it in the town bullets, no sight named; Pildappa Rock is the draw and is a separate candidate (rule 1/2).

stronger_left_out.name: Port Kenny
stronger_left_out.reason: Tiny fishing village; the only source is the Streaky Bay jetty page and names no sight at Port Kenny (rule 1).

stronger_left_out.name: Middleback Range
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source names it as a place to go (searched SATC, Wikivoyage); working iron-ore hills.

stronger_left_out.name: Nundroo
stronger_left_out.reason: Roadhouse locality; no visitor source names anything to see (rules 1-2).

stronger_left_out.name: Spilsby Island
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Sir Joseph Banks Group Conservation Park (an island inside it)

stronger_left_out.name: Louth Bay
stronger_left_out.reason: Only source is an operator experience (Louth Island tour); no place to see on its own (a tour is not a spot).

stronger_left_out.name: Port Gibbon
stronger_left_out.reason: The source is a playground page; a coastal camp settlement with no named sight.

stronger_left_out.name: Mamungari Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Remote desert park on Maralinga Tjarutja country; listings give no walk, lookout or visitor facilities a traveller can do in half an hour, and access is permit/4WD-expedition only.

stronger_left_out.name: Anxious Bay
stronger_left_out.reason: A bay label: searched Wikivoyage, tourism board and parks pages; no counted source names it as somewhere to go.

stronger_left_out.name: Black Springs
stronger_left_out.reason: A campground named in Coffin Bay NP's page (rule 2/3: a camp site, part of the park); the candidate's coordinates are in the Mid North, not Eyre.

stronger_left_out.name: Sleaford Mere
stronger_left_out.reason: Searched parks.sa.gov.au and Wikivoyage: no counted source names the saline lake as a place to visit.

stronger_left_out.name: Reevesby Island
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Sir Joseph Banks Group Conservation Park (an island inside it)

stronger_left_out.name: Corunna Station
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source; a working pastoral station without public visitor access.

stronger_left_out.name: Yumbarra Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Remote park with no named facility, duplicate of the Googs Track area (it lies on the track); counted sources are generic.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Millar Wind Farm
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: working wind farm, infrastructure with no visitor facility or access named

stronger_left_out.name: Koppio
stronger_left_out.reason: Town wrapper: the draw is Koppio Smithy Museum (National Trust, 2.5 acre site), which should be judged under its own name; the locality alone has no counted source.

stronger_left_out.name: Yellabinna Regional Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: single listing on the parks overview; wilderness protection area of remote dunes with no named visitor site or facility

stronger_left_out.name: Nuyts Archipelago Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: For: islands and sea lion/bird tours are a real draw named by the tourism board and Wikipedia confirms the park. Against: boat-only, reached via operators, Franklin Islands prohibited, one counted source.

stronger_left_out.name: Pinkawillinie Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1: single listing for a large inland mallee park with no named visitor feature; remote

stronger_left_out.name: Great Australian Bight Marine Park
stronger_left_out.reason: A marine park along the Nullarbor coast with no single visitor point; whale viewing is at Head of Bight, which is a place to judge separately.

stronger_left_out.name: Chadinga Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1: single listing for a minor park near Ceduna with no named visitor feature

stronger_left_out.name: Sibsey Island
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Sir Joseph Banks Group Conservation Park (an island inside it)

stronger_left_out.name: Calpatanna Waterhole Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Single SATC page; a roadside park on the highway with no named walk, lookout or feature beyond a waterhole; generic bushwalking and camping. Searched SATC only.

stronger_left_out.name: Cape Wiles
stronger_left_out.reason: Headland on the Whalers Way coast with no counted source naming it; covered by Whalers Way.

stronger_left_out.name: Fishery Bay Whaling Station
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Fishery Bay: the remains lie on the same beach and share the same source.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Greenly
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source names it; salt lake with nothing for visitors to do.

stronger_left_out.name: Wahgunyah Conservation Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1: single listing, minor far-west park with no named visitor feature

stronger_left_out.name: Heritage Trail
stronger_left_out.reason: An urban creek-side shared path in Port Lincoln ending at a playground; not a visitor draw.

stronger_left_out.name: Tod River Reservoir
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a local reservoir and reserve near Port Lincoln; single SATC listing with no distinct visitor attraction

stronger_left_out.name: Davenport Creek
stronger_left_out.reason: Candidate coordinates are in Utah, USA, and no evidence a creek reserve is a visitor stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Great White Shark Cage Diving
stronger_left_out.reason: Operator tours, not a place; the place is the Neptune Islands.

stronger_left_out.name: Coffin Bay Oyster Farm Tours
stronger_left_out.reason: Operator tours, not a place (spot is a place, not a business); the Coffin Bay town/oyster walk covers the place.

stronger_left_out.name: Baird Bay Ocean Eco Experience
stronger_left_out.reason: Operator (swim with sea lions tour); the place is Baird Bay itself, which should be judged as a place, not this business.

stronger_left_out.name: Ceduna Museum
stronger_left_out.reason: For: two counted sources list the National Trust museum. Against: very limited opening hours (10am to noon), small local museum.

stronger_left_out.name: Whyalla Steelworks Tours
stronger_left_out.reason: operator bus tour of an industrial site (an operator, not a place); no confirmation it is currently running

stronger_left_out.name: Wild Dog Hill
stronger_left_out.reason: duplicate of Whyalla Conservation Park (the hill is its headline feature)

stronger_left_out.name: Gawler Ranges Wilderness Safaris
stronger_left_out.reason: Operator of 4WD tours, not a place (COVERAGE: a spot is a place).

benchmark: Eyre has no named benchmark places. Linear features (Googs Track, Eyre Highway) are standalone, not under a destination; operators and tours (shark cage diving, oyster tours, Baird Bay Ocean Eco) were rejected and their places (Neptune Islands, Baird Bay) placed; no civic building or minor memorial was kept.
